full_page.content:
SAINT FELIX CAPUCHIN FRIARY HUNTINGTON, IND. January 31st 1953
God bless you and yours Miss Panyard.
Many thanks for your generous favor received yesterday just after our "long distance". I am trying to get this off To-day and its time the collecter were here so pardon haste.
God's blessing to all the works and undertakings of the Panyard Setup.
God bless each and All.
.. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
